Class UserManager

java.lang.Object
model.users.UserManager
public class UserManager extends Object
Manages user data and handles its persistence to and loading from a file system.

This class implements the **Singleton** pattern to ensure only one instance manages the user list across the application.

Responsibilities include:
  • Load users from file into memory.
  • Append new users and prevent duplicates.
  • Handle user login, logout, and session management.
  • Update user experience efficiently by rewriting the file.

  • Method Details

    • getInstance

      public static UserManager getInstance()
      Static method to get the single instance of UserManager (Singleton pattern).
      Returns:
      The Singleton instance of UserManager.
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if an I/O error occurs during the initial loading of users from the file, which is critical for application startup.

    • loadUsers

      public void loadUsers() throws IOException
      Loads users from the file FILE_NAME into the in-memory list users. The method clears the current list before loading to avoid duplicates if called multiple times. Each line in the file after the header should be in the format: "username;password;experience". Only lines with exactly three fields are processed; malformed lines are skipped. If the file does not exist, the in-memory list is set to null and an error message is printed.
      Throws:
      IOException - if an I/O error occurs while reading the file.

    • appendUser

      public boolean appendUser(User user) throws IOException
      Appends a new user to both the in-memory list users and the file FILE_NAME. Before appending, the method checks for duplicates by username using isDuplicate(String). If the user already exists, the method returns false and does not modify the list or file. If the file does not exist or is empty, a header line is written first: "username;password;experience". Each user is stored in the format: "username;password;experience".
      Parameters:
      user - the user to append.
      Returns:
      true if the user was successfully added; false if the username already exists.
      Throws:
      IOException - if an I/O error occurs while writing to the file.

    • login

      public boolean login(String username, String password)
      Attempts to log in a user by matching the provided username and password against the in-memory list of users users. If a matching user is found, currentUser is updated to this user and the method returns true. Otherwise, the method returns false.
      Parameters:
      username - the username of the user attempting to log in.
      password - the password of the user.
      Returns:
      true if login is successful; false if no matching user is found.

    • printUsers

      public void printUsers()
      Prints all users currently loaded in the in-memory list users. This method is primarily intended for debugging purposes. It prints the username, password, and experience of each user to the console.

    • deleteAllUsers

      public void deleteAllUsers()
      Deletes all users from both the in-memory list users and the file FILE_NAME. The in-memory list is cleared, and the file is overwritten with only the header. Any IOException encountered during file writing is printed to the console.

    • updateUserExperience

      public void updateUserExperience(User user) throws IOException
      Updates the experience of a specific user in the in-memory list and persists the change to the file. This method uses a temporary file approach to efficiently replace the single updated line without loading all content into memory, followed by deleting the original file and renaming the temporary file.
      Parameters:
      user - the User whose experience should be updated (the object must contain the new experience value).
      Throws:
      IOException - if an I/O error occurs while updating the file or during file rename/delete operations.
